text:
miriam: heads up — site build on main is failing after the docusaurus migration, lots of unresolved anchors showing up :grimacing:

miriam: example errors from the CI log:
```
Plugin: anchor-linker
ERROR: unresolved anchor for /sdk/python/quickstart#installation
WARNING: broken link /guides/migration#old-anchors -> /guides/migration#section-3
```

jordan: yup, this is the classic mkdocs -> docusaurus slug problem. mkdocs keeps some punctuation, docusaurus strips unicode and collapses multiple separators. normalization mismatch.

sam: can we run the repo link-checker across all branches? i can spin up a job: `node scripts/link-check.js --root docs` and dump failures as JSON.

alex: i sketched a tiny transform to normalize anchors in-place for pages we control. gist: 
```js
// pseudo
const slug = text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g, '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, '-');
```
that maps most mkdocs anchors to docusaurus slugs.

lee: for externally authored content (partner pages) i'd prefer redirects instead of surgery. we can add YAML frontmatter `redirect_from` entries on the canonical pages for the handful of broken anchors.

miriam: good call. plan: (1) run link-checker to enumerate failures, (2) apply transform for infra-owned pages, (3) add redirects for partner/legacy pages, (4) add note to migration guide about slug differences. i'll open a PR with steps + script.

miriam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/342 — includes the transform + GH action to run the link checker on PRs. please review when you get a sec.

docs-bot: preview build: https://deploy-preview-342--docs.redwood-inference.com/ — build succeeded (head: 9f8b7a2) :white_check_mark:

jordan: i'll do a quick review of the transform and the action. two asks: 1) make the regex permissive for unicode (normalize NFKD) and 2) add unit tests for ambiguous cases (accents, em-dash).

sam: i can add the GH Action test matrix to run on node 16/18 and a small python link-check tool in case the node one misses edge cases.

alex: pushed a follow-up commit that updates the migration guide with a short table of mkdocs -> docusaurus anchor examples (e.g., "Installation Guide" -> `installation-guide`).

lee: also adding a small note for ops: when we double-check redirects, ping the CDN team to ensure the redirect mappings are reloaded.

miriam: thanks — if nobody objects i'll merge PR 342 after CI passes. tagging @eng-docs for visibility. :pray:

jordan: looks fine to me, just add the NFKD normalization and we're good.

sam: i'll queue a follow-up to add the python link-checker and annotate flaky links.

lee: :thumbsup:

miriam: merging once preview is green. cheers folks!
